title: Kōjō no Tsuki
attribution: "The Moon over the Ruined Castle": music by Rentarō Taki (died 1903), words by Bansui Doi (died 1952), published in the school songbook "Chūgaku shōka" in 1901; both are public domain. This is Taki's original melody, with the raised note (D# here) in the second bar of the phrase that Kōsaku Yamada's later arrangement removed; it shows as out-of-key.
